## What changes

The outcome first, in a few lines: what a person or a developer gets.

## Proof

What you ran and what you saw, with counts.

## Before / after

Only when the change touches what a person sees: the image from `verify-airdesign before-after` and its `| main | this PR |` table, or the one line `No visible change: <why>`.

## Not done

Faults you pinned and follow-ups. Leave out a section that does not apply.
